title: Individually approved health-functional food sales fall to five-year low
summary: Sales fell to KRW 666.2 billion in 2025, a third consecutive year of decline, though the pace of contraction is slowing.

title: Deer antler extract study on NK cell activation published in international journal
summary: Yuhan Care's YC-1101 (HENKIV) increased NK cell activation and proliferation, with enhanced tumour suppression in combination studies.

title: hy researcher wins science ministry award for muscle-health velvet ingredient
summary: Fermented deer velvet probiotic powder is currently Korea's only approved antler-based ingredient for muscle strength maintenance.

title: Biodot develops deer velvet-based natural ingredient platform
summary: The company imports raw velvet from New Zealand and Russia and is expanding into OEM/ODM and customised R&D services.

title: KGC red ginseng research presented on global academic stage
summary: Studies presented at ICSB in the United States reported potential benefits in neuroprotection, blood glucose control and sleep quality.

title: Highest velvet yield at herds of 30 stags or fewer
summary: Farms with 30 head or fewer average 12.3kg of velvet per stag, the highest per-head production in a national farm survey.

title: Study claims domestic Korean velvet outperforms imports
summary: A Seowon University report commissioned by the Korea Deer Association found higher extraction yields in domestic elk velvet.

title: Why domestic velvet cannot supply traditional Korean medicine
summary: The 1996 herbal medicine standardisation policy still blocks direct farm sales into medical channels, keeping imports dominant there.

title: Korean deer farmers follow world deer biology congress remotely
summary: Research presented at the congress links first-year protein feeding levels to lifetime velvet productivity in stags.

title: Rory McIlroy hosts most expensive Champions Dinner in Masters history
summary: The USD 318-per-person menu included grilled elk sliders, reported in Korea as a venison burger.

title: JungKwanJang launches children's nutrition campaign for Cheonnok Growing Kids
summary: The campaign products contain New Zealand SAT-grade deer velvet alongside red ginseng and herbal extracts.

title: Call for urgent research into PLS for the deer velvet farm sector
summary: The Korea Deer Breeders Association asked for residue data and safety standards for drugs used in velvet harvesting.

title: Aging workforce and high costs top challenges for Korean deer farmers
summary: A survey found 82.5% of deer farmers are in their 60s or 70s, with rising costs cited as the biggest internal obstacle.

title: Korean deer velvet self-sufficiency rate recovers to 20%
summary: The rise is attributed to a sharp fall in imports from 386 tonnes in 2023 to 279 tonnes in 2024, while domestic output edged up.

title: Haman county faces dilemma after culling sika deer following mascot launch
summary: Authorities culled abandoned sika deer a month after launching a deer mascot, prompting calls for non-lethal management.
